versions.changelog:
Initial release of html2app.

- Package local HTML/CSS/JS sites or frontend builds into offline Electron desktop applications for macOS and Windows.
- Guides correct selection of input (static files vs. framework build output) and details compatibility limitations.
- Provides strict security defaults for Electron configuration and details icon handling, including fallback generation.
- Covers platform-specific build, artifact verification, and correct handling of local SQLite storage.
- Includes preflight toolchain checks, platform packaging guidance, and reporting requirements for output artifacts.
